constraints.description: Every Tauri phase-plan criterion is mapped to direct evidence or an explicit blocker.

validation.validation_method: acceptance matrix, task receipts, source inspection, and final manifest

constraints.description: Mobile execution is represented only by exact target-host responses, permission denials, environment metadata, visual receipts, and recomputed artifact hashes.

validation.validation_method: device-evidence manifest, tagged BDD, response matching, and SHA-256 recomputation

constraints.description: Implementation, plugin certification, OpenSpec archive, full-release certification, and publication states remain independent and fail closed.

validation.validation_method: final-verification dimensions, implemented plugin gate, alpha package version, and separate publication authority

constraints.description: Android and iOS success/denial visuals are legible, Prometheus-branded, inspected at original resolution, and hash-bound.

validation.validation_method: original-resolution screenshot inspection, Android UI XML, exact rendered text, and SHA-256

constraints.description: Public ledgers, coverage, docs, skills, research, tests, and final evidence remain synchronized.

validation.validation_method: release tests, ESLint, coverage, skills, JSON/XML, OpenSpec, and diff hygiene

constraints.description: OpenSpec archive may proceed only after real Android/iOS receipts and the clean Rust/BDD lane pass; stable publication remains separately unauthorized.

validation.validation_method: device receipt presence and hashes, clean verifier/BDD receipts, archiveReady=true, and publicationAuthorized=false

global_rules: pnpm remains the JavaScript monorepo entry point.
Tauri MockRuntime and packaged native source cannot certify Android or iOS execution.
The default Tauri capability remains read-only and native snapshots remain in-memory.
Completing this bounded change may authorize its OpenSpec archive only; it cannot authorize npm latest, GitHub Release, Pages deployment, or full 3.0 certification.
termination_conditions: Terminate only when evidence-disposition validation failures are zero.
Terminate with archiveReady=true only when every mobile receipt and clean gate is verified.
Keep publicationAuthorized=false and fullReleaseCertified=false because those are owned by later release changes.
